0022600146.text: The Memphis Grizzlies, who are 4-0 and riding a four-game winning streak, make their fifth game of the season a road trip to Portland, where they are 3-0 away from home. The Trail Blazers are 2-0 and will be without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 122-114 defeat in Memphis on March 4.
